animation.reason: Source-backed N/A: cases.json and expected.json explicitly mark this case animation optional, and source.md Task requests NIC/observed-egress visualization without asking for motion. The six volunteered animated routes are inspected but earn no pass. Their five samples alternate A/B/A/B/A at 100ms intervals: neither monotonic direction nor sparse slow cadence/full traversal is established. Every sampled route has exactly one dot, with zero sampled corner/bridge/junction/arrowhead/border/label violations; optional motion does not damage traceability. Were directed slow animation required, these samples would be insufficient and the evidence would be blocked, not passed. No exemption is applied to any required-animation case.

arrow_traceability.reason: All nine drawn route occurrences (eight source relations) have distinct, continuous stems and unique correct arrowheads. V1 has one two-elbow dogleg; no crossing, bridge, shared run, outside-box junction or fake branch appears. The source requires no bus. F3 concerns label ownership rather than geometric endpoint tracing. Dots never obscure arrowheads in the supplied samples.

border_integrity.reason: All 11/11 node occurrences have four complete sides and four corners with one continuous normal perimeter color; all 11/11 have their own complete bold RGB(216,166,87) selected perimeter in the all-selected ANSI captures. Zero uncheckable node occurrences. No edge interruption or corner loss. Simultaneous selection does not prove solo-selection interaction, but such interaction is not a separate required gate. Timestamped diagram bodies lack color; the normal and selected ANSI snapshots provide the required border color evidence.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: ANSI shows semantic families rather than arbitrary per-depth color cycling: inactive/active ports are related gold hues; server1/server2 are related teal hues; the two Airtel hops are related teal hues in the upstream view; fabric is pink and pool/internet distinct within their views. Placement follows the host/NIC assembly, local /29 peers and ordered upstream chain. Cross-view hue reuse/stability is not a separate rubric gate; generator requests for per-group overrides do not establish a blocker.

layout_fit.reason: Geometric fit passes: both actual captured grids are 77x47 at natural 100%, all boxes and chosen labels are complete, no clipping or overlay occlusion, no pan/zoom required. The free? label touching the spare-box corner does NOT break this gate: its cells and the corner remain distinct and readable, and the rubric does not require a blank margin. The full category nevertheless fails its explicit complete-source-coverage clause: across the split views the public-address prefix and server2 model remain absent (F1-F2); a split map in generation.json cannot supply missing visible content. Independently measured live-pane columns are unavailable, reported separately as null rather than invented.

semantic_fidelity.reason: All nine historical node identities have counterparts and all eight endpoint pairs are drawn, with the NIC->gateway relation repeated across views. However no capture provides the 103.19.91 address-prefix key for any shortened host/gateway/pool address; server2 loses its source-backed R7725 model; and same /29 has an uncertain owner adjacent to the different NIC->gateway arrow. These are recoverable only from external source/spec knowledge, not visible labels. Correctly qualifies dark ports and free addresses and avoids an unproven ToR or invisible switches. See F1-F3.

workflow_evidence.reason: Verified actual hashes of frozen skill, executable, rubric, dataset, source, expected, both final specs and all manifest-listed final capture artifacts, plus unchanged blind record. Separate corrected DeepSeek generator identity and actual Sol reviewer identity match stage-B contract/schema; metadata explains the stale undefined-4 tab label and pane rectangle limitation. Frozen hash-matching harness plus manifests/transcripts preserve exact executed arguments, merged check stdout/stderr and exit 0, timestamps, normal/selected/motion states, and close probes for all three owned capture panes including superseded w7E:p7F. Both viewport tokens and startup lines are present. No pane art was pasted into review chat; no live rerender occurred. Pane rectangle/columns remain unavailable, not silently equated to app dimensions. The rubric pass_iff contains stale gpt-6-astra prose, superseded explicitly by required_reviewer_model, stage-B contract and schema constant Sol.

cleanup.reason: All three generator-owned capture panes, including the superseded v2 pane, have confirmed_closed manifests. Frozen harness closes each pane and probes pane get failure before recording that result. Reviewer opened no panes and performed no new live probes.

findings.description: The supplied 103.19.91.58/29 public host address and same-prefix gateway/server2/pool identities are shortened to .58/.57/.59/.60-.62 with no visible 103.19.91 prefix key in either view. A reader cannot recover the public network identity or confirm the source address from these captures. no NAT, no v6 does not supply the missing prefix. This is source-content loss, also failing layout_fit complete split-source-coverage, not geometric clipping.

Source and extracted node s2 identify server2 as Dell R7725, but the only visible server2 occurrence says server2 .59. Showing R7725 on server1 does not communicate that server2 shares the model. The generator calls this duplicate information in its ledger, but the missing subject-to-model association is not supplied by any captured key or label. Also contributes to incomplete split-source coverage in layout_fit.

The required same /29 qualifier has an uncertain visible owner: [22,34,8,1] is beside the NIC->gateway down arrow at (31,34), but its intended server2->gateway horizontal route is row36. Thus the drawn server2 link geometry is traceable while its source-required subnet membership label is not reliably attached. A spec assignment cannot repair visible ownership.
